name: Rogers Communications Canada nationwide outage (July 8 2022)

Over 12M customers lost wireless/wireline services for ~24h. External BGP withdrawals were symptoms, not causes. Detector observed 141 origin_hijacked events with AS812 victim during recovery window.

name: Orange Spain (AS12479) RPKI credential compromise invalidating ~2M IPs
ground_truth_source: APNIC blog "Digging into the Orange Espana Hack" (2024-01-26)
notes: Attacker used stolen RIPE credentials to log into Orange Spain's RIPE NCC account (no 2FA) and create invalid RPKI ROAs for Orange Spain IP space, pointing them at ASN 49581 (a non-Orange ASN). Networks performing RPKI origin validation rejected Orange Spain announcements starting ~14:20 UTC; AS5511 (Orange Spain's transit) propagated impacted /12s. Reachability mostly restored by 18:00 UTC. Detector observed 5 origin_hijacked events with hijacker_as=AS5511 between 14:39-16:03 UTC.
ground_truth_source_type: cites a human-authored or operator-published account
